claims.explanation: Parachlorophenol is a phenolic antimicrobial that likely acts as a mitochondrial uncoupler/oxidative phosphorylation inhibitor and generates reactive oxygen species, so selectivity is driven by dependence on oxidative phosphorylation and by antioxidant capacity rather than by a single annotated target. Lines with KEAP1/NFE2L2 pathway mutations or high antioxidant programs would be protected, while lines with intact mitochondrial dependence and low antioxidant buffering are sensitized. The observed enrichment of TP53 and RAS/BRAF pathway mutations in sensitive lines is consistent with altered redox and metabolic stress responses rather than a specific oncogene addiction.

features.basis: KEAP1 loss activates NRF2 antioxidant response, buffering phenolic ROS; KEAP1-mutant NCIH1623 is an exception but NFE2L2-mutant lines are largely in the protected set
NRF2 pathway activation increases antioxidant capacity against phenolic oxidative stress; NFE2L2-mutant SNUC5 is sensitive but several NFE2L2-mutant lines are protected
TP53 loss impairs DNA damage/oxidative stress response and is enriched in sensitive lines
KRAS-driven metabolic reprogramming with increased ROS dependence is enriched in sensitive lines
BRAF-mutant lines show increased oxidative metabolism and are enriched among sensitive lines
STK11/LKB1 loss impairs AMPK-mediated metabolic stress adaptation, sensitizing to mitochondrial/redox stress
SMAD4 loss is enriched in sensitive pancreatic/colorectal lines and may impair stress-response signaling
CDKN2A loss is common in sensitive lines and may reflect increased proliferative/redox stress
ALK-altered lines (NCIH2452, KELLY, SKNSH) are among the most sensitive, possibly via altered metabolic signaling
ARID1A mutations are enriched in the least-affected lines, suggesting chromatin remodeling alters stress response
PTEN loss activates PI3K/AKT survival signaling; PTEN-mutant lines appear in both sets but several protected lines carry PTEN mutations
EGFR-mutant HCC4006 is sensitive, possibly through oncogenic metabolic dependency
